## Requirements

- Remove `.github/workflows/sync-task-project.yml` and `docs/project-automation.md`.

## ProjectWeave scope

- Remove the PAT/Secret onboarding recommendation from README, docs/usage.md and projectweave/setup.py initialization output.
- Document manual onboarding or GitHub’s built-in auto-add (one workflow per repository/Project); users manually set Status Todo and AI execution Ready.
- State that labels/Issue closure do not automatically synchronize AI execution, closed Issues are not executable, and users can set Not ready after completion.
- Retain Item closed / explicit complete guidance for Done; do not claim to have identified the earlier Status reversion’s source.
- Update existing initialization tests affected by the wording change and run meaningful relevant tests and diff/link checks.

## Acceptance

Main contains no current references to the removed PAT automation, the relevant tests pass, and this Issue is completed by a reviewed and merged PR produced by the Task execution.
